name: Thunder
author: john@rooney.scot
description: Pterodactyl egg for the Thunder modpack - a Minecraft 1.20.1 Forge modpack combining technology, magic, and building mods. Uses packwiz for automatic server-side mod synchronisation.
startup: if [[ "{{CLEAN_INSTALL}}" == "1" ]]; then rm -rf mods config/packwiz-installer.toml; fi; java -jar packwiz-installer-bootstrap.jar -g -s "{{PACKWIZ_SIDE}}" {{PACKWIZ_EXTRA_FLAGS}} "{{PACKWIZ_URL}}"; if [[ -f unix_args.txt ]]; then java -Xms128M -XX:MaxRAMPercentage=95.0 @unix_args.txt; else java -Xms128M -XX:MaxRAMPercentage=95.0 -jar "{{SERVER_JARFILE}}"; fi

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends curl jq ca-certificates
cd /mnt/server
if [[ "${INSTALL_SCRIPT_SOURCE}" == "release" ]]; then
  curl -sSfL "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rooneyj9005/Thunder/refs/tags/$(curl -sSfL https://api.github.com/repos/rooneyj9005/Thunder/releases/latest | jq -r '.tag_name')/install.sh" | bash
else
  curl -sSfL "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rooneyj9005/Thunder/refs/heads/main/install.sh" | bash
fi

variables.name: Packwiz URL
variables.description: URL to the pack.toml file. Points to Thunder's GitHub Pages by default.

variables.name: Minecraft Version
variables.description: Target Minecraft version. Must match the version required by the modpack.

variables.name: Build / Loader Version
variables.description: Forge build number or Fabric/Quilt loader version. Leave empty for auto-detection. Thunder requires Forge 47.4.13.

variables.name: Server Jar File
variables.description: Server jar filename. Only used by Fabric/Quilt and legacy Forge. Modern Forge uses unix_args.txt instead.

variables.name: Packwiz Side
variables.description: Which side of mods to install. Use 'server' for dedicated servers.

variables.name: Clean Install
variables.description: Wipe the mods folder before each startup to force a fresh packwiz sync. Set to 1 to enable, 0 to disable.

variables.name: Extra Packwiz Flags
variables.description: Additional flags passed to packwiz-installer-bootstrap. Admin use only.

variables.name: Enable RCON
variables.description: Enable the Minecraft RCON protocol for remote console access.

variables.name: RCON Port
variables.description: Port for RCON connections. Must not conflict with the game port.

variables.name: RCON Password
variables.description: Password for RCON authentication. Change from the default before enabling RCON.

variables.name: Installation Script Source
variables.description: Admin-only: Select whether to use the installation script from the main branch or the latest release tag.
